reason: The hypothesis combines the concept of chemical short-range order (SRO) enhancing dislocation cross-slip from P37 and P35 with the cross-slip-induced strengthening mechanism from P5 and P26, and applies this combined mechanism to a new, single-phase Ti-Ni-based HEA system not studied in those passages. It proposes a specific processing route (HPT + low-temperature aging) to induce SRO, which is a synthesis of ideas from different papers into a new proposal for this alloy class.
